title: Dog Riding Bicycle
description: A light brown dog with floppy ears and a black collar sits upright on a silver bicycle, its front paws resting on the black handlebars as it stares directly at the viewer. The background consists of abstract, painterly brushstrokes in vibrant orange, teal, and purple hues.
